CapacityCan.definition: The amount of soda that one can container holds, in milliliters.

CapacityBottle.definition: The amount of soda that one glass bottle container holds, in milliliters.

MinimumTotalVolume.definition: The minimum total volume of soda that needs to be bottled each day, in milliliters.

RatioCansToBottles.definition: The minimum ratio of number of cans to number of glass bottles.

MinimumGlassBottles.definition: The minimum number of glass bottles that must be produced.
